analyticalQuestion: Can joint amplitude-direction heat cancellation convert the physical-time heat volume into the K^-2 weighted-BV budget?

palettePolicy.mode: hard two-root cap: navy and rust plus neutrals

supportedClaim: Common heat and one exact global-smooth 2D3C NSE family show that physical-time weighted heat volume alone is two frequency powers too small to pay weighted BV; an uncontrolled cutoff refresh has an additional exact positive cost.
claimBoundary: The common-heat model is not NSE. The true NSE panel is a closed-form fixed-window limit for one fixed smooth radial two-ring multiplier, not the preselected broad dyadic frame. The refresh panel does not reject a fixed transported partition. No unconditional BV, regularity, singularity, originality, or Millennium claim is made.
